name: Sarumaru no Dayū
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 5); Porter’s note gives the dates as: not later than 800.

poems.title: I hear the stag’s pathetic call
poems.author: Sarumaru no Dayū
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 5
poems.text:
I hear the stag’s pathetic call
Far up the mountain side,
While tramping o’er the maple leaves
Wind-scattered far and wide
This sad, sad autumn tide.

poems.title: 5. 奥山に 紅葉ふみ分け なく鹿の (Okuyama ni momiji fumiwake naku shika no)
poems.author: Sarumaru no Dayū
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
奥山に 紅葉ふみ分け なく鹿の
聲きく時ぞ 秋は悲しき
